items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: his mother used to have the whole band down there on Saturday, and she'd have Boston baked beans and codfish cakes and Boston brown bread

ctx.x: I met his mother when I was in Boston.

Do you remember when they used to feed -- his mother used to have the whole band down there on Saturday, and she'd have Boston baked beans and codfish cakes and Boston brown bread. Oh, delicious, and sometimes hot rolls.
